source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 AC Current Load, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
original_meaning: AC current consumed by a load.
mapping_boundary: Keep AC distinct from DC and consumption distinct from production.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 AC Current Source, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
original_meaning: AC current produced by a source.
mapping_boundary: Not stored charge, capacity, or consumption.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 AC Voltage Load, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
original_meaning: AC voltage used by a load.
mapping_boundary: Not source-side voltage or a supply rating inferred from a reading.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 AC Voltage Source, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
original_meaning: AC voltage provided by a source.
mapping_boundary: Do not interchange source and load roles.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Active, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
original_meaning: True reports the device actively carrying out its responsibilities.
mapping_boundary: Not merely enabled and not independent proof of successful physical effects.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Armed, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–24)
original_meaning: Boolean arming state; the source associates its presence with arming before active command invocation.
mapping_boundary: An arming-state description is not an authorization, command, or performed action.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Attached Orientation, printed p.9 (PDF pp.24–25)
original_meaning: Orientation in the attached parent's local frame, applied after Attached Position; Orientation takes precedence on conflict.
mapping_boundary: Source requires Relationship.parent link ATTACHED; not a network-membership inference.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Attached Position, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: Translation in a physically attached parent's local frame, before Attached Orientation.
mapping_boundary: Not a world coordinate or an inferred installed mounting point.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Brightness, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: Whether automatic brightness is enabled.
mapping_boundary: Enabled adjustment is not its resulting brightness or a factory default.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Contrast, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: Whether automatic contrast is enabled.
mapping_boundary: Separate enabling flag from current contrast.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Focus, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: Whether automatic focus is enabled.
mapping_boundary: Separate enabling flag from current focus or successful focusing.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Gain, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: Whether automatic adjustment of signal gain is enabled.
mapping_boundary: Not a current gain magnitude or a measured outcome.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Level, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: Whether automatic adjustment of pixel values is enabled.
mapping_boundary: Does not supply a missing precise definition of the separate Level property.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Auto Scan, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: Whether automatic scanning is enabled.
mapping_boundary: Not scan area, cadence, completion, or performed observation.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Brightness, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: Current brightness expressed as Percent.
mapping_boundary: Percent is a source type; do not invent an absolute luminance unit.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Built In Test Result, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–25)
original_meaning: General State describing results of the last built-in test that ran.
mapping_boundary: Result is not the self-test command, test capability, or independent health certification.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Camera Mode, printed p.10 (PDF pp.25–26)
original_meaning: Current camera mode; source defines switching and simultaneous-mode representation separately.
mapping_boundary: Camera-specific subtype of a general operating-mode row; do not turn mode-components into guaranteed physical devices.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Capability Version, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: Configuration version for the particular component, compared by ISA to a software release number.
mapping_boundary: Not automatically hardware, software, or standards version.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Charged, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: Boolean reporting whether the component is charged.
mapping_boundary: No percentage, threshold, charge chemistry, or actual capacity is defined here.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Contrast, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: Camera contrast relative to its maximum.
mapping_boundary: Not brightness, gain, or an observed environmental contrast measure.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Crypto Filled, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: Boolean indicator described by ISA as crypto key filled.
mapping_boundary: Not key material, algorithm choice, trust verification, or authorization proof.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 DC Current Load, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: DC current consumed by a load.
mapping_boundary: Keep DC distinct from AC and consumption from production.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 DC Current Source, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: DC current produced by a source.
mapping_boundary: Not load current or an energy-capacity measurement.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 DC Voltage Load, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: DC voltage used by a load.
mapping_boundary: Not necessarily a supply rating or source output.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 DC Voltage Source, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: DC voltage provided by a source.
mapping_boundary: Not load voltage, battery state of charge, or stored energy.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Data Inputs, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–26)
original_meaning: Associative collection describing data being received; Data Transfer supplies endpoint and optional transfer state/rate/completion.
mapping_boundary: Transfer occurs outside the ISA connection; not a signal input definition or a transducer-channel inventory.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Data Outputs, printed p.11 (PDF pp.26–27)
original_meaning: Associative collection describing data being sent, using Data Transfer.
mapping_boundary: Source distinguishes ongoing transmission from merely available resources; not a reported output-field schema.
dependency_terms: ["Data Transfer", "URL", "General State", "General Code", "Measured Mbpsec", "Mbpsec", "Percent", "Associative Array", "Name Value Pair", "Wildcard"]

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Enabled, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: True indicates that the device is allowed to become active.
mapping_boundary: Not the Active flag, a successful operation, or general access-control proof.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Eye Safe Distance, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: Source-reported minimum eye-safe distance, using Measured Meters.
mapping_boundary: A model field is not a verified safety limit for a specific installed device.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Field of Regard, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: Total camera/component view over the scan time; uses the Field of View angular structure.
mapping_boundary: Different from instantaneous field of view and from a world-space footprint.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Field of View, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: Instantaneous angular view; width is required and height can be absent when unknown.
mapping_boundary: A missing vertical angle is unknown, not zero; distinguish type from same-named property.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Focus, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: Current focus expressed as Percent.
mapping_boundary: Not focal distance or a physical lens setting inferred from the percentage.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Frame Rate, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: Frame rate of camera-produced video, using Measured Hertz.
mapping_boundary: Not device heartbeat, observation period, or command update rate.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Frequencies, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: List of frequencies in use by an emitting component, using Measured Hertz.
mapping_boundary: Not the full supported-band catalogue or evidence of a command being issued.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Ground Intercept, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: Geographic position where the component's pointing vector meets the ground.
mapping_boundary: Not the sensor's own position, mounting point, or observed target identity.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Hardware Version, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–27)
original_meaning: Version of hardware used by the component.
mapping_boundary: Accepted extension in this edition; not core by virtue of a table-of-contents bullet.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 IP Addresses, printed p.12 (PDF pp.27–28)
original_meaning: Interface-name-to-current-address associations, with plus-suffixed subinterface naming for multiple addresses.
mapping_boundary: Not UCI, device serial number, physical interface containment, or a mandated CSAPI URL.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Identity, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: MIL-STD-2525-based classification through Standard Identity, including symbol and optional confidence.
mapping_boundary: Not manufacturer, model, serial number, or persistent component identifier.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Iris Size, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: Iris size expressed relative to its maximum.
mapping_boundary: Not an absolute aperture diameter or f-number.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Level, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: Source declares a Percent single value; no property-description prose is supplied.
mapping_boundary: Related level commands describe a setting but do not uniquely establish its measured/controlled referent.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Link Loss, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: Source declares a Db single value; no property-description prose is supplied.
mapping_boundary: Do not infer packet-loss rate, propagation attenuation, a reference power, or a sign convention.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Link State, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: Associative Boolean status: true for interface up and false for interface down.
mapping_boundary: Not the physical ATTACHED/DETACHED Link type or general component availability.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Local Orientation, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: Rotation from the component's standard position in its own frame, after Local Position.
mapping_boundary: Not parent-relative Attached Orientation or world orientation; preserve transform order.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Local Position, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: Translation from standard position in the component's own frame, after attached transforms and before Local Orientation.
mapping_boundary: Not an absolute geographic location or a substitute for the attachment relationship.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Maintenance, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: People or groups to contact for maintenance, as a list of POC structures.
mapping_boundary: Accepted extension; not service history, a maintenance event, or a prescribed interval.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Manufacturer, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–28)
original_meaning: String naming the component's manufacturer, producer, or vendor.
mapping_boundary: Source permits a vendor/producer label; do not assert it always names the actual fabricator.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Manufacturer POC, printed p.13 (PDF pp.28–29)
original_meaning: Manufacturer contact list using the POC extension; source advises also supplying Manufacturer for compatibility.
mapping_boundary: Accepted extension distinct from the core Manufacturer String property.
dependency_terms: ["POC", "String", "Custom Type", "Custom Type Declaration", "Field Declaration", "Resource Descriptor", "Resource Type", "Name Value Pair", "Wildcard", "URL", "UTC"]

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Model, printed p.14 (PDF pp.29–29)
original_meaning: String identifying the component's model within its manufacturer's product line.
mapping_boundary: Same subject required; not a serial number, arbitrary nickname, or firmware version.

source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Serial Number, printed p.16 (PDF pp.31–31)
original_meaning: Component serial identifier unique within its manufacturer's model line; the full manufacturer/model/serial tuple is expected to be unique.
mapping_boundary: Hardware interpretation requires a physical component; serial alone is not declared globally unique.
